## Required values

The GCP values files set these keys live. Replace every `<YOUR_*>`
placeholder with your own value before installing. The chart's values schema
rejects a placeholder left in any `global.*` key below, and an empty
`global.bucketName`, `global.optuneAddress` or `global.roleId`.
The other keys are not schema-checked and fail only once the platform runs,
so fill them in with the same care.

| Value | Template value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `global.cloudProvider` | `gcp` | Cloud provider. One of: aws, azure, gcp, or empty string for single-node / bare-metal. |
| `global.cloudRegion` | `<YOUR_GCP_REGION>` | Cloud region the cluster runs in, such as us-west-2, us-east1 or southcentralus. Used for live instance pricing lookups (AWS/GCP/Azure retail catalogs). |
| `global.bucketName` | `<YOUR_GCS_BUCKET_NAME>` | Object storage bucket. S3 / Blob account+container / GCS bucket for cloud, MinIO bucket name for single-node. |
| `global.roleId` | `<YOUR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL>` | Cloud identity (IRSA ARN / UAMI client ID / GCP service account). Required on azure and gcp. On aws, empty leaves pods on the EKS node role or EKS Pod Identity. Omit for single-node / bare-metal. |
| `global.optuneAddress` | `<YOUR_PLATFORM_HOSTNAME>` | Public hostname of the platform, such as platform.example.com. |
| `specificai-inference.storageProvider` | `gs` | URI scheme of the Triton model repository in object storage: `s3` on AWS, `gs` on GCP. Azure reads the models from the mounted Blob container instead (`models.blob.enabled`). |
